variants.title: Normal modes of two coupled LC circuits
variants.sample: Two equal LC circuits, 10 mH and 1 uF, coupled by a mutual inductance
variants.unknown: the normal mode frequencies, the coupling constant and the beat period
variants.note: The coupling coil pair gives a mutual inductance M = 1 mH; the in-phase mode sees L + M and the opposite-phase mode L - M, so kappa = M / L. Periods are read on a storage scope. Component values are illustrative.

source.title: Coupled LC circuits (H. J. Pain, The Physics of Vibrations and Waves)
